question: Will MAFF's weekly POS survey show rice above ¥2,788 per 5 kg for Oct 26 – Nov 1, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Japan's agriculture ministry (MAFF) weekly supermarket POS survey figure labelled for the survey week 2026-10-26 to 2026-11-01 reports a national average rice price strictly above ¥2,788 per 5 kg.
- "No": That same figure is ¥2,788 or lower.

Clarifications:
- Use the survey's headline national average price per 5 kg for all rice as published, not a single brand or a blended-rice category.
- The figure must be the one explicitly identified as covering the survey week Mon 26 Oct – Sun 1 Nov 2026; MAFF publishes each Monday–Sunday week on the Friday after it ends (Japan time), and the ksppos.pdf file is overwritten with the newest week, so the survey week shown on the release must match.
